issue: Duplicate email address not rejected during registration
actual: System allowed creation of a second account with the same email address (testuser2024@test.com) using a different username (DifferentUser). System should reject duplicate emails.
evidence: Successfully registered TestUser2024 with testuser2024@test.com and password123. Then successfully registered DifferentUser with the same email testuser2024@test.com. Both accounts were created and logged in.

Successfully edited profile with bio 'I love exploring new technologies and building amazing things.' and comma-separated interests 'Technology, Gaming, Web Development'. Changes were saved and displayed on public profile.

Successfully created discussion with category 'Technology', title 'Best practices for API design in 2024', and body content. Thread displays all values correctly and appears at /thread/thread-1787599773876.

Successfully added reply 'Great question! I always follow the REST principles and ensure consistent naming conventions across all endpoints.' Reply appeared immediately without manual reload. Discussion reply count increased from 0 to 1 in both the metadata and Replies section heading.

Successfully upvoted and downvoted both discussion and reply. Upvote counts updated immediately from 0 to 1 when adding upvote, and from 1 to 0 when removing. Button state also reflects active/inactive appropriately. Tested multiple toggle operations.

Search functionality tested with multiple scenarios: (1) Keyword "API" returns matching discussion in title; (2) Lowercase "api" returns same results (case-insensitive); (3) Unmatched keyword "xyzabc123notfound" shows clear empty result feedback: "No threads found." with suggestion "Try adjusting your search terms."

Successfully navigated to Technology category which showed only Technology discussions. Then switched to Creative Corner category which displayed completely different set of Creative Corner discussions. Each category link shows [active] state when selected, and only discussions matching that category are displayed.

Most Active discussions correctly ordered by reply count from highest to lowest: 89, 67, 45, 41, 38, 34, 31, 23, and 1 replies. The Most Active button shows [active] state when selected. Discussions are properly ranked by reply activity.

Successfully opened author's public profile from discussion. Profile displays: username (DifferentUser), bio (I love exploring new technologies...), interests (Technology, Gaming, Web Development), join date (Joined about 20 hours ago), reputation (0 reputation), and authored discussions (1 thread listed).

Logged out then logged back in with same credentials. All user data persisted: bio ('I love exploring new technologies...'), interests (Technology, Gaming, Web Development), authored discussions (1 thread), reply count (1 replies), upvote state (1), reputation (0), and join date all remained intact.

issue: User session not persisted across page reload; user logged out after page reload
actual: After page reload, user was logged out (showed Login/Register links) and encountered 'User not found' error on profile page. Session data did not survive the page reload.
evidence: Logged in user navigated to profile, then reloaded page via browser navigation. After reload, user was logged out and unable to access profile that had just been visible.

Attempted to create discussion with all fields empty. System showed error message 'Please fill in all fields' and did not create any thread. Page remained on /new-thread form indicating validation prevented submission.

issue: Incorrect password accepted; logged-in session created despite invalid credentials
actual: Attempted login with email tech@example.com and incorrect password 'wrongpassword'. System created logged-in session showing 'Welcome back!' and user profile as TechExplorer, despite wrong password.
evidence: Login form accepted wrongpassword and redirected to home page with active session, violating basic authentication security.

issue: Unauthenticated user able to access /new-thread without redirect to login
actual: Navigated to /new-thread while not authenticated; page did not redirect to login screen. System allowed unauthenticated access to discussion creation page.

evidence: Trending discussions displayed in order of upvote counts from highest to lowest: 156, 124, 92, 89, 78, 67, 56, 47, and 47 upvotes. Each discussion's upvote count decreased or remained equal going down the list, confirming proper sorting by upvote count.

Discussion reply counts displayed consistently in both the metadata header and replies section. For example, my API design discussion showed '1 replies' in both the top metadata and the 'Replies (1)' section heading. Added reply count matched both locations.

issue: Trending and Most Active views do not display stated time window for recent popularity
actual: Trending and Most Active discussion lists displayed without any indication of the time window (e.g., 'last 7 days', 'last 30 days') used for ranking. No time period information visible to users.

evidence: Community Stats sidebar consistently displayed across multiple pages: 1,045 Threads, 4,823 Replies, 892 Members, 47 Online. Counts remained consistent when viewing different discussion pages, categories, and profiles, indicating accurate real-time tracking of community metrics.
